hostingBoundary: one operator-owned Windows Docker Desktop canonical workspace

scope.projects: explicit canonical project -> exact normalized checkout; only declared Core aliases
scope.ports: union of actual resolved app-owned Compose publications and declared host launchers 80/8001/8111
scope.sources: full checked-out consumer/provider HEAD revisions; selected Workbench path is carried unchanged through admission, operation and publication; not an image qualification or dirty-tree certificate

resourceIdentity: actual full container ID or host PID plus UTC process birth, exact checkout and published ports
acquisition: explicit holder, issue/PR purpose, UTC expiry within eight hours; live unreserved inventory needs operator handover bound to scope and inventory digests
mutation: whole-operation fence then locked durable admission before I/O; explicit operation token; reobserve and atomically publish actual inventory plus success/failure without masking native exit status
expiry: refuse new changes; original holder may teardown; explicit named reclaim always requires handover and preserves prior history
interruption: retain unfinished operation; recovery/reclaim first prove whole-operation fence free, then require explicit holder/operator receipt bound to actual inventory
release: only admitted holder, successful teardown and zero canonical containers/listeners; failure or remaining resources retains active holder
incidentalTests: noncanonical projects not binding reserved ports remain independent and are never selected for cleanup
